about: Hunter step 3's net trap creatures, where live has them, each by its young trees: swamp lizards in the Canifis Hunter area and north-west of Slepe, orange salamanders in the Uzer Hunter area, the Necropolis Hunter area and on the Abalone Cliffs, red salamanders in the Ourania Hunter area and on Charred Island (the Wiki puts Charred Island's six on one tile). Each tile and type is the creature's OSRS Wiki page (its location table). Wander ranges are guessed (4). Left out: black salamanders (the Wilderness thread) and tecu salamanders (Varlamore).
